purpose: Define cardinality and foreign-key/reference binding semantics for schema relations so local/relation instance binding can be validated before data access.

owns: Relation Cardinality and FK Binding semantics

topics.name: Relation Cardinality and FK Binding
topics.purpose: Define cardinality and foreign-key/reference binding semantics for schema relations so local/relation instance binding can be validated before data access.

semantics.cardinality_rule: Relation cardinality is explicit where applicable.
semantics.fk_rule: Foreign-key/reference fields bind explicitly to target schema/field identities.
semantics.integrity_rule: Required relation integrity constraints are explicit and validated.
semantics.instance_binding_rule: DWH/UserModule `relation` binding requires a predeclared compatible relation/FK binding.
semantics.delete_rule: Cascade/restrict/nullify or other lifecycle behavior is explicit rather than inferred.
semantics.storage_rule: Physical DB foreign key may implement canonical relation but does not define its identity.
semantics.authority_rule: Relation existence does not grant traversal/data access authority.

invariants.rule: Schema, field and relation identities are explicit and stable; instance data, presentation labels and physical storage never define canonical schema semantics.

hard_gates.condition: relation binding used without predeclared relation/FK
cardinality inferred from observed data only
physical FK becomes canonical relation identity

references.purpose: Cardinality/FK semantics belong to explicit relations.

prose.summary: Define cardinality and foreign-key/reference binding semantics for schema relations so local/relation instance binding can be validated before data access.
